runScript.description: Script (relative to the case) executed by the Run button.

cleanScript.description: Script (relative to the case) executed by the Clean button.

logFile.description: Log file the convergence monitor follows. Omit to auto-follow the newest log.* file.

solverPath.description: Explicit solver source for the "Open Solver Source" button: a .C file or a directory containing it. Absolute, or relative to the case. Overrides the automatic search in the OpenFOAM installation — useful for custom solvers.

monitors.description: Extra values scraped from the log with regular expressions.

name.description: Label shown in the monitor panel.

regex.description: Regular expression with one capture group — group 1 is the value.

plot.description: Also plot the (numeric) value as a chart series.

table.description: CSV file path (first row = parameter names) or inline array of parameter objects.

mode.description: substitute: replace @name@ tokens in case files. script: run apply.script inside the copy (params exported as PARAM_<name>).

script.description: Script executed inside the case copy when mode is "script".

files.description: Restrict substitution to these files (relative to the case).

run.description: Command run inside each case copy. Defaults to the case run script.

script.description: Post-processing script run inside the finished case copy.

deleteCase.description: Delete the case copy after successful post-processing (to save disk space).

casesDir.description: Directory (relative to the case) where copies are created.
